notes.title: Fantasy Blacksmith DLC Escape From The Forge This Friday on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Enjoy 4 new locations, teleportation, new resources, and ores for mining.
[/h1]

[b]This DLC features:[/b]

[list]
[*] portal which can be placed in the forge and can be used for teleportation to the outside world.
[*] 4 stones available in store, which transports the character to different locations.
[*] 4 new locations: Graveyard, Forest, Mines, and Cave.
[*] search and mine rare resources in the new locations.
[*] 2 new ores, which can be mined in certain locations.
[*] the book with all in-game items and the locations where you can find them.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591070/Fantasy_Blacksmith__Escape_From_The_Forge/

notes.title: Winexy Major Update #9 (New Levels, Updated Engine, Minor Changes)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/376e73d4ca61602756a0af30aa0333b99534234e.jpg[/img]


[b][u]Added:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Added preparation mode before the main game
[*] Added 4 new levels
[*] Added more useful messages for the player
[/list]
[u][b]Reworked/Changed:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Updated game engine to a newer one
[*] Generally improved optimization
[*] Improved player interface and menu (added animations and sounds)
[*] Improved collisions of some objects
[*] Corrected some checkpoints
[*] Obstacles at Maze level 3 have been eased
[*] Obstacles at Water 2 and Water 3 have been eased
[*] Increased light radius in radioactive ball
[*] Conveyor working in Fog 2 level is smoothed out
[*] Improved lights on some levels
[*] Some minor changes and improvements
[/list]
[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare issue with the "Play" button
[*] Fixes an issue with timer
[*] Fixes an issue with disappearance of lights of some lamps in Dark levels
[*] Some minor fixes
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/577740/Winexy/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/959520/Fantasy_Blacksmith/
